title: Data Sharing Permission
subtitle: Explicit consent for unified agricultural verification and pre-qualification
purposeDesc: Allows KrishiSetu to fetch land, crop, and bank readiness from simulated registries to evaluate subsidy eligibility and Kisan Credit limits.
validityNotice: Valid for 30 minutes. You can withdraw permission and delete temporary cached records at any time.
consentRevoked: Consent has been withdrawn. No source system was contacted.
withdrawalDetails: All temporary dashboard caches and unsubmitted application snapshots have been purged.
